title: GhostCart Finch API: POST /api/finch/plan request
description: One outfit photo and a budget. Send with the header 'Authorization: Bearer <token>'.

image_url.description: A public https URL of a JPEG or PNG outfit photo. AISUM downloads it, so it must be reachable without cookies.

budget_usd.description: Budget for the whole outfit in US dollars. The items returned add up to at most this.

gender.description: Optional, only when the shopper chose it: F (women) or M (men). Omit for no gender filter. null is not accepted.
